ValidationRule.description: Requires a PRICE be entered if this deal is anything but a LEAD
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Setup.TSGADX__ADX_Settings__c.TSGADX__Validation_Rules__c && NOT($Setup.TSGADX__ADX_Settings__c.TSGADX__Executing__c) && AND ( OR ( ISPICKVAL( TSGADX__Type__c , "Replacement"), ISPICKVAL(TSGADX__Type__c, "New Placement")), ISBLANK( TSGADX__Price__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must enter a Price before you can save this deal.
